description: Official draw results for one game: South African National Lottery games (with prize divisions, winners and jackpot), UK 49's, EuroMillions, Irish Lotto, US Powerball, Mega Millions, Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana and Gosloto. Omit date for the latest draw. Gosloto and Kenya with a date return every draw that day. Uses 1 API call from your ResultsZA plan.

date.description: Draw date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest draw.

draw_id.description: Gosloto only: one draw by its number (ignored when date is given).

draw_name.description: Nigeria or Ghana only: one draw, e.g. "PREMIER BINGO" or "Ghana Lucky Tuesday". Omit for all.

kenya_type.description: Kenya only: daily draws or the Mega Jackpot.

name: get_lottery_results
title: Get lottery results
